Stakeholder concerns raised in 2024:
■ Do you have systems in place to
manage emerging risks.
■ How are you approaching
collaboration to enhance levels of
financial inclusion.
■ How are you approaching
collaboration to accelerate the
businesses contribution to the
SDGs.
Our Response:
■ We updated our Enterprise Risk Management
Framework which was cascaded throughout the Group to
identify and respond to emerging and new risks.
■ We regularly and consistently engage with regulators on
issues of interest to them.

enhance broader sector performance.
